# Notes on deployment

In today's fast-paced world, shipping matters. Let's dive in.

Here's the thing: deploys fail. Don't get me wrong, CI helps. At its core, a deploy is a promise.

This guide will walk you through the steps. Our tool could potentially save you hours.

Furthermore, rollbacks are fast. Moreover, logs are kept. Notably, alerts fire.

We test every change. We review every diff. We ship every day.

Code review without tests is just theater. Let that sink in.
